title: Three Sundays and One Short Table
subtitle: 休息休闲 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 休息休闲（人与自我·生活与学习·休息与休闲）
meta: 主题语境：休息休闲（人与自我·生活与学习·休息与休闲）　|　核心词汇：hobby　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hobby 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1997 the worker ① kept the hobby that no classmate in the club would have described, and he said the keeping was the whole of the Sunday. The ② hobby, meaning the interest itself and not the table, ran three Sundays and stayed undescribed in the book; a hobby, he said, is the only thing in a club that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ hobby in that club had the same short table beside it, and the ④ hobby at the far corner, meaning the stamp they kept for the children to sort and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A hobby, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the worker said the describing is the part that fills three Sundays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hobby was the whole of the matter, meaning the pleasure and not the interest. The ⑥ hobby, meaning the pleasure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; hobby, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a interest and a pleasure. He said the pleasure is the part they remember.

By 2002 the ⑦ hobby had become a line in a card, and the card had become an argument about the short table. The ⑧ hobby of the whole thing, the worker wrote in March, was one club and three Sundays of describing; hobby, he said, is either the stamp at the far corner or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hobby I remember is the interest described in the card, which closed in 2004 and is still described as the quietest in the club. A ⑩ hobby, my mother said in 2006, is the only interest that improves by being described; every hobby, she said, is a pleasure that has agreed to look like a interest. She said the pleasure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 业余爱好（指活动室里每一项旁边的那一项）
B. n. 业余爱好（指那项爱好本身，与桌子相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the hobby 保持一项爱好
D. n. 业余爱好（指留给孩子们整理的那一枚那一项）
E. n. 爱好之事（抽象总称，指一处活动室的爱好之事）
F. n. 业余爱好（指卡片里写到、被记下的的那一项）
G. n. 乐趣、消遣（指一件事里人人都玩却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 消遣（抽象总称，指人人都玩却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the hobby that no classmate in the club would have described
The hobby, meaning the interest itself and not the table
the hobby at the far corner
the hobby was the whole of the matter
the hobby had become a line in a card
The hobby of the whole thing
A hobby, my mother said in 2006

answers.why: keep the hobby 意为“保持一项爱好”，1997 年那位工人把活动室里没有一位同学肯描述的一项爱好做了一遍。
hobby 意为“业余爱好”，指那项爱好本身而不是桌子，它经过了三个星期天而在簿子上没有被描述。
hobby 意为“业余爱好”，指活动室里每一项旁边的那一项，每一项旁边都有同一张窄窄的长桌。
hobby 意为“业余爱好”，指最远那个角落留给孩子们整理的那一枚那一项，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hobby 意为“乐趣、消遣”，指一件事里人人都玩却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份乐趣就是那件事的全部。
hobby 意为“消遣”，指人人都玩却无人提起的那样东西而不是那项爱好，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hobby 意为“业余爱好”，指卡片里写到、被记下的的那一项，到 2002 年这一项成了卡片里的一行。
hobby 意为“爱好之事”，工人三月写道，整件事的爱好之事是一处活动室和三个星期天的描述。
hobby 意为“业余爱好”，我记得的是卡片里描述过的那一项，2004 年搁下了，至今仍被说成活动室里最安静的一项。
hobby 为抽象总称，母亲 2006 年说，爱好是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的爱好。
